message.content:
Yes – you can file a noise‑complaint in Atlanta.  The city’s noise ordinance is enforced by the **City of Atlanta Police Department** and the **City Hall Code‑Enforcement Office**.  The city council can’t take a complaint directly, but they can forward it to the proper department and will often follow up on persistent problems.

### How to file a complaint

| Method | What to do | Contact |
|--------|------------|---------|
| **Phone** | Call 311 (or 404‑656‑4000) and ask to speak with the Noise Complaint line. | 311 / 404‑656‑4000 |
| **Online** | Use the City of Atlanta 311 portal: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> → “File a Complaint” → “Noise.” | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> |
| **Email** | Send a brief description of the issue to noise@atlantaga.gov. | noise@atlantaga.gov |
| **In‑person** | Visit City Hall at 55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303.  Ask for the Code‑Enforcement Office or the Police Department’s Noise Unit. | 55 MLK Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303 |

### Key details

* **Noise Ordinance** – See Section 20.1.1 of the Atlanta Municipal Code for the legal limits and enforcement procedures: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/sites/default/files/2022-12/Noise%20Code.pdf>.
* **Council Contact** – If you prefer to speak with a council member, you can reach the council office at 404‑656‑4000 or via the council’s website: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/council>.  The council can forward your complaint to the Police Department or Code‑Enforcement Office if needed.

### Quick steps

1. **Gather details** – Date, time, location, description of the noise, and any evidence (audio clip, photos, etc.).
2. **Choose a method** – Phone, online, email, or in‑person.
3. **Submit the complaint** – Provide the details and any evidence.
4. **Follow up** – If you don’t hear back within a few days, call 311 again or check the status online.

Once filed, the Police Department will investigate and, if necessary, issue a citation or order a remedy.  The council can review the case if you feel the response is inadequate.
